start.dialog: Sailors are going missing near the Singing Rocks—they claim to hear beautiful voices calling them into the water! Some say it's sirens, but I think it's something else. Investigate, but don't get enchanted yourself!
start.objective: Investigate the disappearances near the Singing Rocks

progress.dialog: Not sirens—Void-tainted dolphins! The Collapse left pockets of corruption underwater. They're singing a psychic distress call! You need to purify the water around them using these Aether Crystals!
progress.objective: Use Aether Crystals to purify the Void-tainted water

complete.dialog: The dolphins are healed! They're swimming circles around you in gratitude! One left you a gift—a Sirenscale that can emit a sonic blast! And the sailors have stopped disappearing!

party_comments.kade: I almost jumped in after that song... good thing Nix7 grabbed me!
party_comments.twist: The Void reaches even beneath the waves. Terrifying.
party_comments.nix7: Psychic aquatic mammalian distress: resolved. Void contamination: neutralized.
